aroma: Red berries, dried herbs, citrus peel
description: Maison Roy & Fils' 2014 Incline Pinot Noir blends red fruit, dried herbs, and citrus peel in a graceful, finely layered style. The palate has depth without heaviness, carrying the vintage's ripeness with measured freshness.
imagePrompt: Photorealistic studio bottle photograph of a 2014 Maison Roy & Fils Incline Pinot Noir from Willamette Valley.
sommelierNotes: Serve at 15-16°C with duck, cedar-plank salmon, or porcini risotto; a gentle decant is appropriate for sediment.
